This petition has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail to the petitioner in case F.I.R. No.136 dated 31.03.2023 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 364 and 34 IPC, and Sections 364-A/365/451/342/170/419/420/201 added later on at Police Station Division No.7, District Ludhiana.

The same is taken on record.

sentences.text: Today at time about 8:20 PM phone call of S u n n y A r o r a c a m e t o m e a n d h e s a i d 1 o f 3 N e u t r a l C i t a t i o n No:=2023:PHHC:162030 2023:PHHC:162030 that 4 police officials in civil uniform have come at our shop in one white colour Swift Car and they aie taking him with them.

Short while later I went at my shop and came to know from adjoining shopkeepers that they have taken away Sunny Arora in white colour Swift Car No.
PB10-EC-4020.
When I checked my shop then I came to know that they had also stolen money from the cash-box.

In the meantime, phone call of Sunny Arora came and when I answered the phone call then some other persons were speaking on phone and they said to me that they are officials of CIA Staff and have brought my servant with them, we shall take action against him.

I pleaded to them on phone and then they said that we are standing at Tajpur Road Near Dashmesh Dairy, arrange Rs. 25000/-and then we shall release your servant Sunny Arora else we shall take action against him.
I was going to Tajpur Road to secure release of my servant.
I have doubt that they are fraud persons and they have kidnapped my servant with intention of causing bodily harm to him.
You have met on the way.
Please help me.
I alongwith you reached near Dashmesh Dairy, Tajpur Road and one Swift Car No. PB10-EC- 4020 was standing there and two persons were standing outside near it.
When I alongwith you tried to go near the car from distance then on seeing you two persons who were standing out of car fled away.

I alongwith you went to the spot and checked the car and my servant Sunny Arora was sitting at back seat, one person having trimmed skull hair was sitting at driver seat of car and another person having trimmed skull hair had held Sunny Arora captive at back seat.

On asking by you the person sitting at driver seat disclosed his name as Bhawanjit Singh son of Amarjit Singh resident of Bhamian Khurd and person sitting at backseat disclosed his name as Rajvir Singh son of Gurdeep Singh resident of Khasi Kalan, Ludhiana.
On asking by you Bhawanjit Singh disclosed the name of persons fled away from the spot as Gautam resident of Basti Jodhewal, Ludhiana and Ankit Sharma resident of Choti Bhamian.
Statement recorded to you, heard, is correct.
Action be taken.

xxxx "

Challan already stands presented and investigation is complete and thus there can't be any apprehension that the petitioner shall tamper with the evidence.
5. State Counsel is not in position to dispute the aforesaid factual assertions made by counsel for the petitioner based on record of the case.
6. I have heard counsel for the parties and have gone through records of the case.

7. Without commenting on the merits of the case, keeping in view the incarceration already suffered by the petitioner and the fact that the investigation already stands concluded and Challan stands presented thus custody of the petitioner cannot be prolonged as a punitive measure, the present Bhawanjit Singh vs State Of Punjab on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93488024/
2 petition is allowed.
